literal_meaning: ঘুর = turn; প্যাঁচ = twist (twists and turns)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর কথায় অনেক ঘুরপ্যাঁচ আছে, সরাসরি বলতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: There are many twists in his words; he can't speak directly.
Playing twists and turns is common in politics.
note: Variant form 'ঘোরপ্যাঁচ' may be used interchangeably for emphasis
